name: code-quality
description: Focused review and improvement of code comments, docstrings, and API explanations, with practical before-and-after examples.

interface.longDescription: Review, complete, and rewrite comments to explain code responsibilities, processing steps, data meaning, and interface contracts without changing behavior.
defaultPrompt: Use $code-quality:code-comment-standard to review comments in the requested files. Explain specific reading gaps and show focused rewrites without editing files.
